hits.snippet: # AWS Embeds Superblocks Vibe-Coding Inside Enterprise Private Clouds AWS and Superblocks have launched a multi-year collaboration letting enterprises deploy AI-assisted internal apps entirely inside their own AWS virtual private clouds using Amazon Aurora, S3 and Bedrock. Kaan Tınmaz Aug 8, 2026 Updated Aug 10, 2026 AWS Embeds Superblocks Vibe-Coding Inside Enterprise Private Clouds [Amazon](https://theroboticsmedia.com/company/amazon) 's AWS unit and vibe-coding startup [Superblocks](https://theroboticsmedia.com/company/superblocks) unveiled a strategic multi-year collaboration on August 3, 2026 that embeds Superblocks 3.0 directly inside AWS customers' private clouds, letting business users build AI-assisted internal apps without exposing data or prompts to third-party model providers. ## What ships Superblocks 3. 0 spins up Amazon Aurora databases within the customer's own AWS account, integrates with Amazon Bedrock for model access and inherits the customer's IAM policies, audit logs, encryption keys and network controls.
